title: Cube partial derivative
statement: Let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, let $S$ be a subset of the $n$ coordinates, and let $mu:\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\mathbb R$. Define the partial derivative associated with $S$, evaluated at $mu$, by summing over all coordinate sets $T$ containing $S$: the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $T$ multiplied by the product of $mu_i$ over $i\in T\setminus S$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$S$ is a finite set of coordinates
$mu$ assigns a real number to each coordinate
